title: Grateful Dead Live at Berkeley Community Theater on 1971-08-15
source: Recording Info: SBD > MR > C > DAT; Transfer Info: DAT > Sony D8 > WAV > Sound Forge 10 > TLH > FLAC; Upgrade of existing sources. No shn or CDR in lineage. Transferred, tracked and mastered by Bill Guarneri, August 7, 2014

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a high‑energy 1971 show with a standout 'Rider' performance.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as unbelievably clear for a 1971 tape, thanks to Bill Guaneri’s mastering work. The concert delivers the classic ’71 shoot‑’em‑up energy, with the band in fine form and “Rider” highlighted as a highlight. Overall it’s considered a must‑have addition to any summer‑’71 collection.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers gave 4–5 stars, emphasizing both strong musical energy and surprisingly high recording quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, crisp audio; Bill Guaneri’s source improvements make the sound unusually vivid for a 1971 tape.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Typical 1971 shoot‑'em‑up momentum with solid pacing; the show feels cohesive and energetic throughout.
